post.description: Drops all data and re-seeds initial static data (admin areas, countries, etc.). Call for one, multiple, or all countries. Not available in production. Returns immediately; seeding continues in the background.

parameters.name: skipStaticRasters
parameters.description: If true, skip seeding static rasters (population) to speed up resets for testing.

parameters.name: resetIdentifier
parameters.description: Optional identifier for this reset action, will be logged by the server.

parameters.name: countryCodes
parameters.description: ISO3 country codes to seed. Provide comma-separated (e.g. MWI,UGA). If omitted, all countries are seeded.

409.description: A reset is already in progress.

post.summary: Reset database and seed initial (non-event) data.

post.description: Creates mock forecast events, for testing without pipeline data. Call for one, multiple, or all supported countries. Not available in production.

parameters.name: clearEvents
parameters.description: If true, clear existing events for the given countries before creating new ones.

parameters.name: issuedAt
parameters.description: ISO8601 date for the forecast issuedAt (e.g. 2026-08-19T14:37:32.907Z). Defaults to now.

parameters.name: countryCodes
parameters.description: ISO3 country codes to mock. Provide comma-separated (e.g. MWI,KEN). If omitted, all seeded countries with mock support are mocked.

post.summary: Generate mock events for one, multiple, or all countries.
